card.name: Stronghold and formidable as strong descriptors
card.fires_on: The words "stronghold" and "formidable", usually right after "a" or a group name, in general prose. It also fires on "vigorously" after "shaken".

modes.label: Stronghold
modes.description: The noun "stronghold" for a place or area held firmly by a group or species.
modes.example: A trove of ancient manuscripts in Hebrew characters rescued from caves in a Taliban<< stronghold>> in northern Afghanistan

modes.label: Formidable
modes.description: The adjective "formidable" after "a", describing an obstacle, challenge or background.
modes.example: Vogel brings a<< formidable>> background to his depiction of Deng's efforts

modes.label: Vigorously
modes.description: The adverb "vigorously" after shaken or agitated in handling instructions.
modes.example: Do not administer if ASPARLAS has been shaken or<< vigorously>> agitated, frozen, or stored at
